speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit by the candle. Open your mouth. I am not asking about the play until I have seen the tooth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the left.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He came in with a clove in his cheek and a face like a shut door.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Hold still. I have looked at horses with more patience than you are offering.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then look, and be done. I am not a horse.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The nether great tooth, on the left. It is black at the neck. You'll lose it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will settle.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It will settle when it's in a dish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It answered a crust at dinner. I have a clove. I am not going to a barber tonight.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A clove is a kitchen mercy. It is not a cure. Black at the neck does not turn because a man has an evening free.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Does it pain him where he says, or where the candle finds it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: For once, the same place. Here.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then believe the finger, and do not believe the hope. I have seen this colour.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Leave him the clove. If you take it out to look, you will look again before the hour is gone.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He may keep the clove. He may not tell me it is well.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not say it was well. I said it will settle.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And I have answered you. In a dish. Eat on the other side.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is pottage, if you have learned anything since the crust.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Pottage. I have had one crust today, and it introduced itself.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I am not feeding that tooth on purpose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Pope asked where it pained, and I told him. Burbage offered a progress to the barber. Agnes offered a clove or a needle. I took the clove.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You refused the barber.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I refused the barber, and I did not ask for the needle.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the kitchen stays a kitchen. I am glad of that.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will not have a needle heated in my house tonight. Eat, and go up when you are fed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The clove stays in. I have a page that will not go, and I mean to sit with it till ten and then stop.
